gloss: cabinet minister; member of the cabinet

definitions.gloss: cabinet minister; member of the cabinet
definitions.explanation: A government official who serves as a member of the cabinet, typically heading a ministry or government department.

examples.japanese: {閣僚|かくりょう}{会議|かいぎ}が{開|ひら}かれた。
{新|あたら}しい{閣僚|かくりょう}が{任命|にんめい}された。
examples.english: A new cabinet minister was appointed.

examples.japanese: {閣僚|かくりょう}の{一人|ひとり}が{辞任|じにん}したことで、{内閣|ないかく}{改造|かいぞう}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: A cabinet reshuffle was carried out after one of the ministers resigned.

notes:
A formal term for members of the national cabinet. In Japan, {閣僚|かくりょう} refers to ministers who serve under the {内閣|ないかく}{総理|そうり}{大臣|だいじん} (Prime Minister). The word combines {閣|かく} (cabinet/council) and {僚|りょう} (colleague/official).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閣僚|かくりょう}{会議|かいぎ}: cabinet meeting
- {閣僚|かくりょう}を{任命|にんめい}する: to appoint a cabinet minister
- {閣僚|かくりょう}{人事|じんじ}: cabinet appointments
- {全|ぜん}{閣僚|かくりょう}: all cabinet members
- {関係|かんけい}{閣僚|かくりょう}: relevant ministers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大臣|だいじん}: minister — the title of individual cabinet members (e.g., {外務|がいむ}{大臣|だいじん} "Minister of Foreign Affairs")
- {内閣|ないかく}: cabinet — the body itself, not the individual members
- {政治家|せいじか}: politician — broader term for anyone in politics
